title: Good ideas deserve thoughtful engineering.
description: From the first technical decision to the software you rely on. Here’s how we can work together.

items.title: Technology consulting
items.description: I help you build a technology-driven business while making the most of your budget. Together, we can choose the right tools, avoid unnecessary costs, and plan beyond the first release—so you build a foundation for growth, not just another piece of software.

items.title: Software development
items.description: From everyday apps to advanced systems software, my team and I can bring what you need to life across platforms. Delivery is only the beginning: ongoing support and maintainability help your software stay useful as your needs evolve.

items.title: Independent collaboration
items.description: Have an original idea and the technical skills to help bring it to life? I’m open to teaming up with fellow builders, exploring new directions, and working through the challenges together. Let’s see what we can create.
